title: 2D contour: follow-up of the open-run join (#2487)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Follow-up of PR #2487 (fix for #2277). The review verdict was "no blockers". The items below are not blocking.

Done means: each item below is done or refused with a reason in a comment. The touched tests pass.

## Checklist

- [ ] Update the doc comment at `crates/app/src/operation/contour_open.rs:11-13`. It says a chain whose offset folds onto itself is refused by name. The join now bridges such a hole, so the text is out of date.
- [ ] Update the two "folds onto itself" refusal messages. The `offset_run` wrappers in `contour_open.rs` and `contour_run_side.rs` still give "comes back within twice the offset" as the cause. This cause now occurs only when the chosen side breaks or vanishes.
- [ ] Add a note for the user when the path bridges a narrow mouth and leaves walls uncut. Use `path.notes` when `Region::sweep` returns a CW loop. Pin it with `an_open_run_with_a_bottleneck_notch_bridges_the_mouth`.
- [ ] `join_open_runs` in `crates/geometry/src/boundary_chains.rs:97` removes only runs with the same vertex list. Add a test for an edge plus a chain that contains that edge. Either refuse it with a clear message or pin the clean result.
- [ ] A joined chain whose first and last points match passes as open. Add a test for this case, or refuse it.
- [ ] Strengthen `acute_inside_corner_and_oversized_tool_succeed_open_and_closed`. It asserts only zero warnings and a clean post. Add a clearance assert at the acute corner.
- [ ] Add a join test for `PlasmaProfile` and `WireContour`. Both kinds cut open chains on the centre line.
- [ ] Split `crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs`. The file has 552 lines. The limit is 400 lines.
